doc_friction.issue: Round 3's 'heavier tails: sd 0.50 against MAD 0.32' was read with the weekday pattern left in; like for like the real noise is narrower than the simulated noise (0.356 vs 0.41-0.50), so the named next item pointed at the wrong suspect. Corrected in the new section.
A --dry-run of a long replacement proposed moving an item that still holds an open 'next' (the bunched-count ramp cell) to HISTORY.md rather than NEXT.md; I shortened the text instead.

deviations.why: Round 3 named only one next round; after round 4's surprise (real noise, not closure) I pre-registered and ran a second round (5) in the same session instead of leaving it to a later run
deviations.result: E1 failed: round 4's real-noise effect shrank from 20 to 7 catches on fresh seeds; the write-up says round 4's C2 does not replicate at full size

notes: Two pre-registered simulation rounds (400 + 1,000 simulated shops, Quiet replayed). Round 4: closure no effect (C1 fail), real noise costs 20 (C2 pass), C3/C4 fail. Round 5 fresh seed: E1-E4 fail; catches track false-alert rate; Gaussian noise of the real spread is quietest (44/100, 0.36 per 100). Nothing ships to the CLI/page; llms.txt notes a closure is harmless. Verification: node --test shop-tails.test.mjs (2 pass, 3 s); run_venture_tests.py changepoint-detector (see below); check_posts ok; validate.py ok.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: two pre-registered simulation rounds with scripts, a test and a README write-up, as a statistician would do them

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
